div.div: مُشْدِنٌ [without ة] A doe-gazelle whose young one has become such as is termed شَادِن: (S, K, TA:) or who has a شَادِن following her: and in like manner applied to other animals of the clovenhoofed kind, and of the solid-hoofed, and to a camel: (TA:) pl. مَشَادِنُ and مَشَادِينُ, (S, K,) like مَطَافِلُ and مَطَافِيلُ, (S,) [pls. of مُطْفِلٌ,] the latter pl. anomalous. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
